svg.title: Crypt-Risen: Plunderspell bestiary concept sheet

text.tspan: What sleeps under the keep, and what a misfired CADAVER SURGE wakes.
The one enemy allowed to be supernatural.
A corpse in torn linen grave-wrappings (burial dress, not a uniform),
Bone shows at the skull, hands, shins and through a tear over the ribs.
Lapis leaks from the sockets, the ribs and every joint: the misspoken
Stooped and uneven, one arm limp and one reaching. Pitiable and wrong,
Lapis: Eyes, ribs and joints. Allowed only here, because a spell raised it.

svg.text: Hand-authored SVG · Tools/bestiary_concept_svg.py · concept thumbnail for paint-over, not final art
